offers_products.reason: Grows and manufactures cannabis flower, edibles and vape products sold under its own brands in its dispensaries.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from selling cannabis goods; medical card guidance and dispensary advice are incidental to product sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Retail dispensaries sell directly to medical patients and recreational adult shoppers, with a rewards program and app.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sales are mainly through its own dispensaries to individuals; wholesale to other dispensaries exists but is minor.

recurring_revenue.reason: Patients and loyal shoppers repeatedly buy cannabis products, encouraged by a rewards program.

cyclical_demand.reason: Medical patients and habitual users buy low-cost cannabis regularly and are unlikely to cut back sharply in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Customers make small, frequent purchases of flower, edibles and vapes at dispensaries.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for cannabis goods grown and sold by the company, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual patients and shoppers at its dispensaries.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs cultivation and processing facilities plus 180+ owned or leased dispensaries, requiring continued capital investment.
